item.title: docs: settle Q-1, lesson 45, documentation rules and README map
item.body:
**Problem**
- The audit still lists Q-1 as "Reopened", with a `swift` branch replacing `main`.
- The lesson from the review of PRs #3–#6, and the duplicated ADR 0010, were not recorded anywhere.
- The documentation structure is not described anywhere.

**What changed** (4 files)
- `docs/audit/README.md`: **Q-1 decided** (2026-10-26). SwiftHFR ships as an update of `hfrplus.red.super` (team `QMG83DG7YP`), built from `ezzz/HFRnow:dev-swift`. Import of legacy data (LOT-067) is in scope. Universal links are possible because the site's AASA names this App ID.
- `docs/agents/LESSONS.md`: **lesson 45**. Green CI is not a merge criterion: a spec, tests, a rebase and a review by someone other than the author are required.
- `AGENTS.md`: two additions.
  - **Documentation rules**: AGENTS.md is the only entry point; one file, one role; each task works from one spec file (`docs/lots/` or `docs/features/`); a one-off file is deleted once its outcome is recorded.
  - A learning: list unmerged branches before a structural change.
- `README.md`: new **Documentation** section mapping every document to its role.

**Checks**: markdownlint (0 errors), `check-lot-deps.py` (0 violations). Docs only.

---

Script executed: ```bash git show 3f677c03458fa59ef2f3d622774cc279c38ee271:AGENTS.md | sed -n '156,169p' printf '\n--- refs/remotes ---\n' git for-each-ref --format='%(refname:short)' refs/remotes printf '\n--- local branches ---\n' git for-each-ref --format='%(refname:short) %(objectname:short)' refs/heads printf '\n--- remotes ---\n' git remote -v printf '\n--- branch help ---\n' git branch -h | sed -n '/--no-merged/,+2p' printf '\n--- relevant branch references ---\n' git grep -n -E 'origin/dev-swift|dev-swift|no-merged|fetch --all' 3f677c03458fa59ef2f3d622774cc279c38ee271 -- ':!docs/agents/LESSONS.md' || true ``` Repository: ezzz/HFRnow Length of output: 20481 ---
**Compare unmerged branches with the integration base.** `git branch -r --no-merged` without a commit argument compares against `HEAD`. The `-r` option lists only the remote-tracking refs stored in the local clone. A stale clone, or a checkout of a feature branch, can therefore miss branches that are not merged into `origin/dev-swift`, the integration branch. Fetch the refs first, then pass the base explicitly. ([git-scm.com](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-branch?utm_source=openai))
